policy: Trip.com Group BBP (hackerone.com/trip_com), policy+scope snapshotted 2026-08-29 via h1sync. Gold Standard Safe Harbor. SLA: first response 2 business days (avg 6h), triage 2 days, bounty 14 days. Max bounty $5,500. HIGH-PRIORITY asset = <locale>.trip.com (Crit $2,000-5,500 / High $1,000-2,000); all other wildcard rows are standard tier (Crit $1,000-1,500 / High $500-1,000). RULES (law): detailed reproducible reports required; multiple vulns from one underlying issue = one bounty; no disclosure without express consent; testing against partners (Skyscanner, Google Flights, Kayak etc.) OUT; account brute force without a valid login = no reward; unauth/low-impact CSRF, session-not-invalidated-after-logout, missing security headers, SSRF that cannot obtain relevant server data = no reward. EXCLUDED ASSETS: third-party-service sites (e.g. jobs.careers.trip.com), testing environments that cannot affect production (staging/stg/dev/development.travix.com et al), ordinary user credential leaks. No X-Hackerone header requirement found. Public account registration exists on the brands — own-account testing feasible.
